name: Malabo
subtitle: Malabo, capital of Equatorial Guinea: its numbers, a short history and places to see beyond the World Heritage list.

keyPoints.text: The Catedral de Santa Isabel, completed in 1916, features 40-metre Neo-Gothic spires dominating Plaza de la Independencia.

gaps: Sub-municipal demographic growth data for Malabo II are pending updated release.
First-hand local voices from traditional Bubi elders and island fishermen are still missing.
Some statements were removed on 15 November 2026 because the page cited for them did not contain the quoted words in an automatic check.
